# Experiment results (generated by `experiments.py`)

States expanded = states removed from the frontier and expanded (goal test on removal; the goal itself is not counted). A* ties on f are broken by smaller h, then insertion order.

### Summary

| Test | Path found | Path length | States expanded | Shortest length (independent BFS check) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Test 1: original warehouse | yes | 40 | 63 | 40 |
| Test 2: trivial (goal adjacent) | yes | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Test 3: no solution | no | - | 9 | - |
| Test 4: alternative paths (14 vs 16 moves) | yes | 14 | 24 | 14 |
| Test 4b: many equal shortest paths | yes | 10 | 16 | 10 |

## Task 6: Heuristic investigation

### Laboratory warehouse (optimal length 40)

| Heuristic | Solution found | Path length | States expanded | Optimal? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Manhattan (abs(dx) + abs(dy)) | yes | 40 | 63 | yes |
| h(n) = 0 | yes | 40 | 63 | yes |
| Euclidean (sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2)) | yes | 40 | 63 | yes |
| 2 x Manhattan | yes | 40 | 67 | yes |

### Open warehouse (optimal length 24)

| Heuristic | Solution found | Path length | States expanded | Optimal? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Manhattan (abs(dx) + abs(dy)) | yes | 24 | 36 | yes |
| h(n) = 0 | yes | 24 | 71 | yes |
| Euclidean (sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2)) | yes | 24 | 60 | yes |
| 2 x Manhattan | yes | 24 | 36 | yes |

### Two-route map (Test 4) (optimal length 14)

| Heuristic | Solution found | Path length | States expanded | Optimal? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Manhattan (abs(dx) + abs(dy)) | yes | 14 | 24 | yes |
| h(n) = 0 | yes | 14 | 27 | yes |
| Euclidean (sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2)) | yes | 14 | 24 | yes |
| 2 x Manhattan | yes | 16 | 16 | NO |
